invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.089（基于ATR 0.0005和2%风险），或融资费率Z-score > -5%显示轧空机会消失，或日线跌破$0.085关键支撑。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.089 (based on ATR 0.0005 and 2% risk), or funding Z-score > -5% indicating short squeeze opportunity fading, or daily break below $0.085 key support.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破$2100（基于ATR 11.4508和2%风险），或融资费率Z-score < 5%显示轧多风险降低，或日线突破$2150关键阻力。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above $2100 (based on ATR 11.4508 and 2% risk), or funding Z-score < 5% indicating long squeeze risk reducing, or daily break above $2150 key resistance.
